description: SYNTHETIC finding-precision eval for the deterministic finding gate (src/lib/finding-gate.ts). Every file, line and finding here is invented for this fixture; none is copied from a real repository. One shared PR snapshot; each case is one reviewer finding plus the same reply's own assumptions / investigated_safe / coverage and the bot's earlier findings on the PR. 'pattern' is the false-positive class it models (speculation, design-intent, factual, concurrency, style-policy, stale-head) or 'valid'. 'expect' is the gate outcome under the default Settings (findingGate=rules, every precision switch on); 'gap' marks a false positive the deterministic rules cannot judge (left to the model refute pass).

finding.title: Receipt mail failure is unhandled
finding.failure_scenario: If the outbox dispatcher does not catch listener errors, the worker process crashes on the first failed mail.
finding.root_cause: Whether the dispatcher catches listener errors is unverified; the dispatcher is not in the reviewed group.
finding.recommended_fix: Catch the error in the listener.

finding.title: Refund can be issued twice on a payment timeout
finding.failure_scenario: A slow payment provider times out and the client retries, refunding twice.
finding.root_cause: The payments client is not present in the snapshot; it retries on timeout without an idempotency key.

finding.title: Outbox retry may run the listener concurrently
finding.failure_scenario: Two retries of the same event might send two receipt mails.
finding.root_cause: retryLater may schedule a retry while the first attempt is still running.

coverage.reason: Documents that listeners throw when delivery fails so the outbox retries the event.

finding.title: Listener throws on mail failure
finding.failure_scenario: A failed receipt mail throws out of onInvoicePaid and the event is not completed.
finding.root_cause: The listener throws instead of swallowing the delivery error.

investigated_safe: services/billing/flags.ts: SPLIT_INVOICES defaults off by design; the PR body says enabling it is a follow-up.

finding.title: Split invoices flag defaults off so splitting never runs
finding.failure_scenario: Invoices are never split in production after this PR ships.
finding.root_cause: SPLIT_INVOICES is created with default false and nothing turns it on.
finding.evidence: services/billing/flags.ts:1 `export const SPLIT_INVOICES = flag("split-invoices", { default: false });`
finding.recommended_test: Split path runs with default flags.

cases.label: fp
cases.gap: the throw message itself documents a forward-only migration; judging intent needs the model refute pass

finding.title: down() throws, so rollback is impossible
finding.failure_scenario: Rolling back release 42 fails with an error and the deploy is stuck.
finding.root_cause: down() throws instead of dropping the new column.
finding.evidence: services/billing/migrations/0042_split_invoices.ts:6 `throw new Error("forward-only migration: restore from backup instead");`

finding.title: CLAUDE.md not updated for the resend endpoint
finding.failure_scenario: Operators cannot find the new resend endpoint.
finding.root_cause: The PR diff has no change to services/notify/CLAUDE.md, so the endpoint is undocumented.

finding.title: Refund amount ignores earlier partial refunds
finding.failure_scenario: An invoice refunded twice pays out more than its total.
finding.root_cause: The refund amount is the invoice amount, not the remaining balance.

finding.title: Refund can exceed the paid amount
finding.failure_scenario: A refund larger than the payment is sent to the provider.
finding.root_cause: Re-reading the line: amount is total minus refunded, so this path is safe.

cases.label: fp
cases.gap: both requests run inside one readwrite IndexedDB transaction, which serializes them; only the model refute pass can see that. The deterministic gate demotes the hedged P1 to P2.

finding.title: Item and total writes race
finding.failure_scenario: Two addItem calls interleave and the cart total loses an item price.
finding.root_cause: items.put and totals.put could interleave because nothing locks the totals store.

finding.title: Ref assigned during render
finding.failure_scenario: React may warn in strict mode.
finding.root_cause: lastCount.current is written in the render body instead of an effect.

finding.title: Hard-coded Korean text in the receipt email
finding.failure_scenario: Non-Korean customers get a Korean subject line.
finding.root_cause: The subject and body strings are not localized.
finding.recommended_fix: Move the copy to the i18n catalog.

finding.title: Log message wording is misleading
finding.failure_scenario: On-call reads that a receipt was delivered when only the send call returned.
finding.root_cause: The log line says sent before delivery is confirmed.

finding.title: Spec does not verify the totals update
finding.failure_scenario: A regression in the totals write would not fail this spec.
finding.root_cause: The test only asserts the items store.

finding.title: Refunding an unknown invoice id crashes with a TypeError
finding.root_cause: invoices.find returns undefined for an unknown id and the next line dereferences it.
finding.recommended_fix: Return 404 when the invoice is missing.

priorFindings.title: Refund route lost its admin check

finding.title: Refund endpoint no longer requires admin
finding.failure_scenario: Any signed-in customer can POST /invoices/:id/refund and refund any invoice.
finding.root_cause: The PR removed requireAdmin from the refund route.

finding.title: An error page ends pagination early and drops the rest of the feed
finding.failure_scenario: When /feed returns a 500 for page 3, fetchPage returns [] and loadAll stops, so the user sees a truncated feed with no error.
finding.root_cause: fetchPage maps a failed response to an empty page, and loadAll treats an empty page as the end of the feed.
finding.recommended_fix: Throw on a failed page instead of returning [].
finding.recommended_test: A 500 on page 3 surfaces an error.
